c.seed: economics and business — Philippine coconut oil production monopoly and commodity price volatility in global markets

g.passage: In the early twentieth century, the Philippines became one of the world's leading suppliers of copra, the dried coconut meat pressed for oil used in soap, margarine, and explosives. Colonial-era trade rules gave Philippine coconut oil tariff-free access to the United States, and by the 1920s a small number of mills in Manila controlled much of the export trade. Many observers assumed that this concentration would let the mill owners dictate prices and shield the industry from outside shocks. Yet the mills' control extended only to processing within the islands. The price they could charge abroad was set by competition with palm oil from West Africa, soybean oil from Manchuria, and whale oil from Norwegian fleets, all of which buyers could substitute when coconut oil grew expensive. When a postwar boom collapsed in 1920, export prices fell by more than half within two years, and the Manila mills, despite their dominance at home, could do nothing to halt the decline.
g.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: Tariff-free access to the United States allowed Philippine coconut oil mills to outcompete rival producers of palm, soybean, and whale oil during the 1920s.
Philippine coconut oil exporters suffered after 1920 mainly because a few Manila mills held so much of the trade that smaller producers were driven out.
Philippine coconut oil prices fell sharply after 1920 because buyers in the United States lost interest in soap, margarine, and explosives after the war.
Although a few Manila mills dominated Philippine coconut oil processing, they could not protect prices abroad, where rival oils served as ready replacements.
g.explanation: 지문은 마닐라의 소수 제분소가 국내 가공을 장악했지만, 해외 가격은 대체 가능한 다른 기름과의 경쟁으로 정해졌기 때문에 1920년 이후의 가격 폭락을 막지 못했다는 점을 핵심으로 다루므로 D가 정답이다. A는 관세 혜택이라는 세부 정보는 맞지만, 경쟁 기름을 이겼다는 주장은 지문 내용과 반대다. B는 시장 집중이라는 사실은 맞게 언급하지만, 그 집중이 소규모 생산자를 몰아내 피해를 줬다는 인과관계는 지문에 나오지 않는다. C는 가격 하락이라는 사실은 맞지만, 그 원인을 수요 상실로 돌린 것은 근거가 없다. 지문이 제시하는 원인은 전후 호황의 붕괴와 대체재와의 경쟁이다.
g.explanation_en: D is correct because the passage's main point is that the Manila mills controlled processing at home but could not set prices abroad. Overseas, coconut oil competed with substitute oils, so the mills couldn't stop prices from collapsing after 1920. A gets the tariff detail right, but the passage never says the mills outcompeted rival oils; it says buyers switched to those oils whenever coconut oil got expensive. B correctly mentions that the trade was concentrated in a few mills, but it invents a cause the passage never states, namely that smaller producers were driven out. C correctly notes that prices fell, but it blames lost demand for soap and other products, which the passage doesn't say. The passage instead points to the end of the postwar boom and competition from substitute oils.
g.design: To get this right, you have to connect two pieces of information: the mills' dominance at home, and the fact that prices abroad depended on substitute oils. Each wrong answer starts from a true detail in the passage but adds a false cause or claim.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.
- 세부 기술 힌트: 해당 skill 의 전형적 SAT 문항 형식을 따른다.
c.seed: economics and business — Sikh Punjabi agricultural innovations and canal irrigation systems increasing grain yields nineteenth century

g.passage: In the late nineteenth century, British administrators in Punjab built an extensive network of perennial canals, and official reports often credited these channels alone for the region's sharp rise in wheat output. Economic historian Imran Ali has argued that this account leaves out the farmers themselves. Many of the settlers who received land in the new "canal colonies" were Sikh cultivators from central Punjab who brought established practices with them, such as rotating wheat with fodder crops and carefully leveling fields so water spread evenly. __Without such techniques, Ali notes, canal water frequently pooled in low spots, waterlogging soil and leaving salt deposits that cut yields within a few seasons.__ In his view, the gains in grain production resulted from engineering and farming expertise working together rather than from the canals by themselves.
g.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It explains why the cultivators' practices were necessary for the canals to raise yields, supporting a challenge to the official reports.
It explains why the canals were poorly designed, supporting the claim that British engineering hindered grain production.
It explains why settlers left central Punjab, supporting the claim that soil damage there drove migration to the canal colonies.
It explains why official reports overstated wheat output, supporting the claim that yields in Punjab did not actually rise.
g.design: 정답은 밑줄 문장(기법이 없을 때의 결과)을 앞 문장의 기법 및 마지막 결론과 연결해야 파악됨. 오답은 모두 'It explains why..., supporting...' 동일 틀로, 침수·염분 피해라는 부분적 근거를 각기 다른 잘못된 주장에 연결.
g.explanation: 밑줄 문장은 시크 농민의 기법이 없으면 운하 물이 고여 침수와 염분으로 수확량이 줄었다고 말하므로, 그 기법이 운하가 효과를 내는 데 필수적이었음을 보여 주고 운하만이 원인이라는 공식 보고서에 대한 Ali의 반박을 뒷받침한다. 따라서 A가 정답이다. B는 문제가 운하 설계가 아니라 기법의 부재에서 생긴 것이며, 글은 공학이 생산을 방해했다고 하지 않는다. C의 토양 피해는 중부 펀자브가 아닌 운하 지역에서의 일이고 이주 원인은 언급되지 않는다. D는 글이 수확량 증가 자체를 인정하므로 틀리다.
g.explanation_en: The underlined sentence says that without the Sikh cultivators' techniques, canal water pooled and caused waterlogging and salt that reduced yields, which shows those practices were essential for the canals to work and supports Ali's challenge to the reports crediting canals alone. That makes A correct. B is wrong because the problem came from missing techniques, not canal design, and the text never says engineering hurt production. C is wrong because the soil damage happened in canal areas, not central Punjab, and the text gives no reason for migration. D is wrong because the text accepts that wheat output really did rise.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.
- 세부 기술 힌트: 해당 skill 의 전형적 SAT 문항 형식을 따른다.
c.seed: economics and business — Korean chaebol family business structure and government industrial policy in manufacturing development

g.passage: Economists have long debated why South Korea's manufacturing sector expanded so rapidly between the 1960s and 1980s. One common account credits the chaebol, large family-controlled conglomerates such as Hyundai and Samsung, whose founders could move capital quickly from one affiliate to another and enter new industries without waiting for outside investors. __Yet the chaebol's ability to shift resources so freely depended heavily on the state, which directed low-interest loans from government-controlled banks toward firms that met strict export targets.__ Economist Alice Amsden has argued that this arrangement worked because support was conditional: firms that missed their targets could lose access to credit. On this view, Korea's growth reflected neither family ownership nor government planning alone but the discipline that each imposed on the other.
g.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It presents evidence that the chaebol's founders were reluctant to move into new industries without government approval.
It complicates an explanation introduced earlier by pointing to a condition on which the advantage that explanation emphasizes relied.
It rejects an explanation introduced earlier by showing that family ownership played no meaningful role in Korea's industrial growth.
It summarizes an explanation introduced earlier by restating the advantage that family control gave the chaebol in entering new industries.
g.explanation: 밑줄 문장은 'Yet'으로 시작해, 앞에서 소개한 설명(재벌의 신속한 자본 이동이 성장을 이끌었다)이 강조한 장점이 사실 국가의 조건부 신용 지원에 의존했음을 지적하여 그 설명을 복잡하게 만든다. 따라서 B가 정답이다. A는 창업자들이 정부 승인 없이는 진출을 꺼렸다고 하지만 지문은 오히려 신속한 진출을 말한다. C는 가족 소유가 아무 역할도 없었다고 하지만 마지막 문장은 양쪽 모두의 역할을 인정하므로 지나치다. D는 앞 설명을 단순히 반복한다고 보지만 밑줄 문장은 'Yet'으로 새로운 조건을 덧붙인다.
g.explanation_en: The underlined sentence begins with "Yet" and shows that the advantage stressed by the earlier account (the chaebol's quick movement of capital) actually depended on state-directed, conditional loans. That complicates the earlier explanation, so B is correct. A is wrong because the text says founders entered new industries quickly, and it never mentions them being reluctant. C goes too far: the final sentence credits family ownership and government together, so the text doesn't say ownership played no role. D misses the contrast signaled by "Yet," because the sentence adds a new condition and does more than repeat the earlier point.
g.design: To answer, students have to connect the contrast word "Yet" to the claim about the chaebol in the previous sentence. Choices C and D each match part of that link (the sentence pushes back on the claim, and it refers back to it), so students must compare them carefully to rule them out.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.
- 세부 기술 힌트: 해당 skill 의 전형적 SAT 문항 형식을 따른다.
c.seed: economics and business — Finnish paper and pulp industry dominance through forest management and vertical integration strategy

g.passage: For much of the twentieth century, Finland's paper and pulp companies outcompeted rivals in countries with far larger forests. Economists often attribute this success to vertical integration: firms such as UPM and Stora Enso came to control every stage of production, from timber harvesting to sawmills, pulp plants, and paper machines. __Yet integration alone cannot explain the industry's durability, since Swedish and Canadian firms adopted similar structures without matching Finland's consistency over decades.__ Historian Markku Kuisma points instead to the country's forest management regime, under which hundreds of thousands of small private landowners, guided by state-funded advisers, replanted harvested land on predictable cycles. This steady, renewable timber supply, Kuisma argues, is what allowed integrated mills to operate at full capacity year after year.
g.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It presents evidence that Finnish firms copied an organizational structure first developed by competitors in Sweden and Canada.
It explains how the integrated structure described in the previous sentence helped Finnish firms achieve full production capacity.
It raises a limitation of a commonly offered account, setting up the introduction of an additional factor discussed afterward.
It identifies a weakness in Kuisma's argument by noting that other countries also had small private landowners.
g.explanation: 밑줄 문장은 'Yet'으로 시작하여 경제학자들의 일반적 설명(수직 통합)만으로는 부족하다고 지적하고, 이어지는 문장에서 Kuisma의 산림 관리 체제라는 추가 요인이 소개되므로 C가 정답이다. A는 스웨덴·캐나다 기업이 언급되긴 하지만 핀란드가 이를 모방했다는 내용은 없다. B는 통합과 가동률을 연결하지만 그 연결은 마지막 문장의 Kuisma 논지이며, 밑줄 문장은 통합의 설명력을 오히려 제한한다. D는 밑줄 문장이 Kuisma보다 앞에 나오며 그의 주장을 비판하지 않고, 소규모 토지 소유자 이야기도 하지 않는다.
g.explanation_en: The underlined sentence begins with "Yet" and points out that the common explanation, vertical integration, can't fully account for Finland's success, and the next sentence brings in Kuisma's forest-management factor. That makes C correct. A mentions Swedish and Canadian firms, but the text never says Finland copied them. B connects integration to full capacity, but that link comes from Kuisma in the last sentence, while the underlined sentence actually limits how much integration can explain. D is wrong because the underlined sentence comes before Kuisma's argument, doesn't criticize it, and says nothing about small landowners.
g.design: Distractors reuse real details (Sweden/Canada, full capacity, Kuisma), so a quick skim may tempt a student; picking the answer requires linking "Yet" to the next sentence's alternative explanation.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.

c.seed: economics and business — Moroccan argan oil cooperative movement and fair trade certification for rural women producers

g.passage: Since the 1990s, women in southwestern Morocco have formed cooperatives to process argan kernels into oil, a product increasingly prized by international cosmetics firms. Advocates have presented fair trade certification as a way to guarantee that the price premium paid by foreign buyers reaches these rural producers. __Yet economist Zoubida Charrouf's fieldwork found that in several certified cooperatives, members still earned roughly the same daily wage as uncertified workers, because much of the premium was absorbed by intermediaries who controlled export contracts.__ Charrouf does not conclude that certification is useless; rather, she argues that its benefits depend on whether cooperatives gain direct access to buyers, a condition that certification alone does not create.
g.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It explains why international cosmetics firms began paying higher prices for argan oil produced by cooperatives.
It presents evidence that fair trade certification has failed to benefit argan cooperatives and should therefore be abandoned.
It describes the method Charrouf used to compare certified cooperatives with uncertified ones.
It introduces a finding that complicates a claim made in the previous sentence, setting up the qualified position explained afterward.
g.explanation: 밑줄 문장은 'Yet'으로 시작해, 인증이 생산자에게 프리미엄을 보장한다는 앞 문장의 주장과 어긋나는 현장 조사 결과를 제시하고, 마지막 문장의 조건부 결론(직접 구매자 접근이 필요하다)으로 이어지므로 D가 정답이다. B는 반대 증거라는 점은 맞지만, 마지막 문장이 인증이 무용하다는 결론을 명시적으로 부정하므로 '폐기해야 한다'는 부분이 틀렸다. C는 현장 조사를 언급한 점은 맞지만, 문장은 연구 방법이 아니라 결과를 보고한다. A는 가격 상승의 원인을 다루지 않으며 그 내용은 첫 문장에 있다.
g.explanation_en: The underlined sentence begins with "Yet" and reports a field finding that runs against the previous sentence's claim that certification guarantees producers the premium. It then leads into the final sentence's qualified conclusion that certification works only when cooperatives can reach buyers directly, so D is correct. B gets right that the sentence offers contrary evidence, but the last sentence explicitly rejects the idea that certification is useless, so "should be abandoned" is wrong. C is right that fieldwork is mentioned, but the sentence reports a result rather than describing a method. A is wrong because the sentence doesn't explain why prices rose; that background comes in the first sentence.
g.design: B와 C에 부분적으로 맞는 근거(반대 증거, 현장조사)를 넣어 마지막 문장의 단서와 비교해야만 배제되게 했고, 정답은 '앞 주장을 복잡하게 함 + 뒤의 단서 붙은 입장으로 이어짐'이라는 두 단계 연결이 필요하다.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.

c.seed: economics and business — Swedish iron ore production and Kiruna mining town labor relations company town model

g.passage: In the early twentieth century, the mining company LKAB built Kiruna, a town in Sweden's far north, to house the workers who extracted its iron ore. Like many company towns, Kiruna gave its employer unusual control: LKAB owned the land, designed the streets, and financed the schools and churches. Historians have often assumed that such arrangements left workers with little bargaining power. __Yet Kiruna's miners organized one of the longest strikes in modern Swedish history in 1969–1970, winning concessions on pay structure and working conditions without the backing of their national union.__ Some scholars now argue that the town's very isolation and the shared dependence of residents on a single employer fostered a tight solidarity that made such collective action possible.
g.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It presents a case that complicates a widely held view about the position of workers in settlements like Kiruna.
It presents a consequence of the company's control over Kiruna's land, streets, and public institutions.
It presents evidence that national unions played a central role in improving conditions for Kiruna's miners.
It presents the explanation that some scholars offer for the solidarity among Kiruna's residents.
g.explanation: 밑줄 문장은 'Yet'으로 시작하며, 회사 도시 노동자는 교섭력이 거의 없었다는 역사가들의 통념과 달리 키루나 광부들이 장기 파업으로 성과를 얻은 사례를 제시하므로 A가 정답이다. B는 회사의 통제를 언급한 앞 문장과 연결되지만, 파업은 그 통제의 결과로 제시되지 않고 오히려 예상과 어긋나는 사례로 제시된다. C는 파업이 전국 노조의 지원 '없이' 이루어졌다는 내용과 반대된다. D의 연대에 대한 설명은 밑줄 문장이 아니라 그 뒤 마지막 문장이 제시한다.
g.explanation_en: The underlined sentence begins with "Yet" and describes Kiruna's miners winning a long strike, which runs against historians' assumption that workers in company towns had little bargaining power, so A is correct. B links the sentence to the company's control, but the strike is presented as something that contradicts what that control would lead you to expect, not as its result. C reverses the text, which says the strike succeeded without the backing of the national union. D describes the role of the final sentence, which gives scholars' explanation for the solidarity; the underlined sentence only reports the strike.
g.design: The trap answers all draw on nearby content: B on the earlier description of company control, C on a misreading of the union detail, and D on the sentence that comes after. To get it right, students must connect the word "Yet" to the assumption it pushes back against.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.

c.seed: economics and business — Irish whiskey distillery consolidation and brand marketing recovery after phylloxera crisis decline

g.passage: Histories of Irish whiskey often blame its twentieth-century collapse on outside shocks: Prohibition shut off the American market, and a trade war with Britain in the 1930s closed off much of the British Empire. Yet the industry's weakness arguably started decades earlier. __When the phylloxera insect devastated French vineyards in the late nineteenth century and British drinkers turned away from scarce brandy, Scottish firms won them over with cheaper blended whisky made in column stills, while many leading Dublin distillers dismissed blends as inferior and stayed with traditional pot-still spirits.__ By the time the later shocks arrived, Scotch had already become the whisky most consumers knew. Only after the few remaining Irish producers merged into a single company, Irish Distillers, in 1966 did the industry begin to recover, by closing old plants and putting its marketing behind a small number of internationally promoted brands.
g.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It describes a market shift that the text presents as the direct cause of most Irish distillery closures in the 1920s and 1930s.
It describes an earlier episode that the text uses to qualify a widely accepted explanation of the industry's decline.
It describes a business approach that the text presents as the model for the strategy Irish Distillers later adopted.
It describes an alternative view that the text raises only to dismiss in favor of the usual explanation.
g.explanation: 지문은 먼저 금주법과 무역 전쟁이라는 통상적 설명을 제시한 뒤, "Yet ... started decades earlier"로 그 설명을 보완한다. 밑줄 문장은 필록세라 시기에 아일랜드 증류업자들이 블렌디드 위스키 시장을 놓친 더 이른 사건을 보여 주므로 B가 정답이다. A는 이 사건을 1920~30년대 폐업의 '직접' 원인으로 과장한다. 지문은 이후 충격도 인정한다. C는 1966년 이후의 전략(통합, 브랜드 마케팅)을 이 시기의 스카치 전략과 연결하지만, 지문은 그런 연결을 하지 않는다. D는 방향이 반대다. 지문은 이 관점을 기각하지 않고 받아들인다.
g.explanation_en: The text starts with the usual explanation, Prohibition and the trade war, and then qualifies it with "Yet ... started decades earlier." The underlined sentence gives that earlier episode: Irish distillers missed the blended-whisky market during the phylloxera crisis. That makes B correct. A overstates the sentence's role by calling it the "direct" cause of the 1920s–30s closures, while the text still gives weight to the later shocks. C links Scotland's approach to Irish Distillers' strategy after 1966, but the text never makes that connection. D gets the direction backward: the text accepts this earlier explanation and doesn't dismiss it.
g.design: To answer, students have to connect the "Yet" contrast with the underlined example. Options A and C borrow real details from the passage (closures, later strategy) but distort their role, so they must be compared carefully to rule out.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.
- 세부 기술 힌트: 삽입구·동격·긴 수식어 뒤에서 절 경계(콜론/대시/세미콜론/쉼표+등위접속사)를 판단하거나, 필수/비필수 수식어 쉼표를 가리는 문제. 선택지는 문장부호/접속 조합 4개.
c.seed: economics and business — Georgian wine production and protected designation of origin labels in modern EU trade agreements

g.passage: Georgia's 2014 Association Agreement with the European Union protected eighteen Georgian wine appellations, among them Tsinandali, a dry white from the Kakheti region, and Khvanchkara, a semisweet red from Racha-Lechkhumi______ producers outside Georgia can no longer sell a wine labeled with either name anywhere in the EU's single market.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: , as a result,
and as a result,
; as a result,
, as a result
g.explanation: 긴 동격 목록(Tsinandali, ... Khvanchkara, ...)을 지나면 'Georgia's ... Agreement ... protected ...'라는 독립절이 끝나고, 'producers ... can no longer sell ...'라는 두 번째 독립절이 시작된다. 접속부사 'as a result'로 두 독립절을 이으려면 앞에 세미콜론을, 뒤에 쉼표를 두어야 하므로 C가 정답이다. A와 D는 쉼표만으로 두 독립절을 이어 쉼표 오용(comma splice)이 된다. 지문에 쉼표가 많아 쉼표가 자연스러워 보이지만, 'as a result'는 등위접속사가 아니다. B는 등위접속사 'and'를 쓰긴 했지만, 이렇게 긴 두 독립절을 이을 때 'and' 앞에 와야 할 쉼표가 빠져 있다.
g.explanation_en: Once you get past the long list of appositives (Tsinandali, ... Khvanchkara, ...), you'll see that the independent clause "Georgia's ... Agreement ... protected ..." ends, and a second independent clause, "producers ... can no longer sell ...," begins. When the conjunctive adverb "as a result" links two independent clauses, it needs a semicolon before it and a comma after it, so C is correct. A and D join the two independent clauses with only commas, which makes a comma splice. The passage's many commas make a comma feel natural here, but "as a result" is not a coordinating conjunction. B does use the coordinating conjunction "and," but it leaves out the comma that should come before "and" when it joins two long independent clauses like these.
g.design: 긴 동격 목록 안에 쉼표가 여러 개 있어 절 경계를 놓치기 쉽게 만들었다. 학생은 경계가 어디인지 찾은 다음, 접속부사에 맞는 문장부호까지 골라야 한다.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.

c.seed: economics and business — Peruvian guano trade monopoly and fiscal revenue dependency in nineteenth century colonial economy

g.passage: From the 1840s to the 1870s, guano (the nitrogen-rich droppings of seabirds that had piled up for centuries on Peru's Chincha Islands) became the Peruvian state's most valuable asset. The government, which claimed legal ownership of the deposits, granted consignment contracts to foreign merchant houses such as Britain's Antony Gibbs & Sons to ship and sell the fertilizer in European markets______ arrangement allowed officials to collect enormous revenues without building a broad domestic tax system, leaving public finances dangerously exposed once the deposits began to run out.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: , this
this
, and this,
; this
g.explanation: 빈칸 앞 "The government ... in European markets"는 삽입절 "which claimed legal ownership of the deposits"가 들어 있지만 그 자체로 완전한 독립절이고, 빈칸 뒤 "this arrangement allowed officials ..."도 독립절이다. 두 독립절을 이으려면 세미콜론이 필요하므로 D가 정답이다. A는 쉼표만으로 두 독립절을 이어 콤마 스플라이스가 된다. B는 아무 문장부호 없이 두 절을 붙인 무종지문(run-on)이다. C는 쉼표+and로 절을 바르게 잇는 듯 보이지만, "this" 뒤에 붙은 쉼표가 주어 "this arrangement"와 그 동사 "allowed"를 불필요하게 갈라 놓는다.
g.explanation_en: The text before the blank, "The government ... in European markets," is a complete independent clause even though it contains the interrupting clause "which claimed legal ownership of the deposits." The text after the blank, "this arrangement allowed officials ...," is also an independent clause. To join two independent clauses you need a semicolon, so D is correct. A connects the two clauses with only a comma, which creates a comma splice. B puts no punctuation between them at all, which creates a run-on sentence. C looks like it correctly joins the clauses with a comma and "and," but the comma after "this" wrongly splits the subject "this arrangement" from its verb "allowed."
g.design: 빈칸 앞 독립절 중간에 긴 삽입 관계절을 넣어, 빈칸 앞이 완전한 절인지 판단하기 어렵게 만들었다. 거기에 쉼표+등위접속사 형태로 그럴듯해 보이는 오답 C를 더해, 절 경계 판단과 주어-동사 사이 쉼표 확인이라는 두 단계를 거쳐야 풀 수 있게 했다.

- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.
- 세부 기술 힌트: 삽입구·동격·긴 수식어 뒤에서 절 경계(콜론/대시/세미콜론/쉼표+등위접속사)를 판단하거나, 필수/비필수 수식어 쉼표를 가리는 문제. 선택지는 문장부호/접속 조합 4개.
c.seed: economics and business — Czech glass manufacturing tradition and Bohemian crystal artisan guild knowledge transmission systems

g.passage: In nineteenth-century Bohemia, glassmaking knowledge circulated mainly through guild instruction rather than through written manuals. Master engravers, many of whom had trained in the same village workshops as their fathers, passed cutting techniques to apprentices over years of supervised practice______ formulas for coloring agents such as gold chloride were usually memorized instead of recorded, which helped keep them inside the guild.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: , and
and,
, and,
g.explanation: 빈칸 앞 "Master engravers ... passed ... practice"와 뒤 "formulas ... were usually memorized ..."는 모두 독립절이다. 중간의 삽입구 "many of whom ... fathers"는 주어를 수식할 뿐이므로 절 경계 판단에 영향을 주지 않는다. 두 독립절은 쉼표+등위접속사로 연결하는 것이 맞으므로 A가 정답이다. B는 쉼표만으로 두 절을 이어 쉼표 오류(comma splice)가 된다. C는 접속사 앞에 쉼표가 없고 뒤에 불필요한 쉼표가 있으며, D는 "and"와 주어 "formulas" 사이에 불필요한 쉼표를 넣었다.
g.explanation_en: The words before the blank ("Master engravers ... passed ... practice") form an independent clause, and so do the words after it ("formulas ... were usually memorized ..."). The interrupting phrase "many of whom ... fathers" only describes the subject, so it doesn't change where the clause boundary falls. Two independent clauses can be joined with a comma plus a coordinating conjunction, so A is correct. B joins the clauses with only a comma, which creates a comma splice. C leaves out the comma before "and" and adds an unnecessary comma after it. D puts an unnecessary comma between "and" and the subject "formulas."
g.design: 긴 비필수 삽입구 뒤에서 두 독립절의 경계를 판단해야 하며, 오답은 쉼표 위치만 다른 같은 틀로 구성했다.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.
- 세부 기술 힌트: 삽입구·동격·긴 수식어 뒤에서 절 경계(콜론/대시/세미콜론/쉼표+등위접속사)를 판단하거나, 필수/비필수 수식어 쉼표를 가리는 문제. 선택지는 문장부호/접속 조합 4개.
c.seed: economics and business — Ghanaian cocoa farming cooperatives and direct trade relationships bypassing middleman exporters model

g.passage: Kuapa Kokoo, a farmer-owned cooperative founded in Ghana in 1993, challenged a long-standing arrangement in the country's cocoa trade. Instead of selling beans to licensed buying companies that passed them along to foreign exporters, member farmers pooled their harvests and negotiated directly with chocolate makers abroad. The cooperative's approach, which also gave farmers a share of the profits from a chocolate brand they partly ______ an unusual degree of control over how their crop was priced and marketed.
g.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: own; granted growers
own, granted growers
own—granted growers
own: granted growers
g.design: 주어 "The cooperative's approach"와 동사 "granted" 사이에 쉼표로 시작한 비필수 관계절이 끼어 있어, 닫는 부호를 같은 쉼표로 맞춰야 하는 2단계 판단(삽입절 경계 확인 + 짝 부호 일치)을 요구한다. 대시·콜론·세미콜론 오답은 각각 그럴듯한 구두점 용법을 갖추고 있다.
g.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 "The cooperative's approach"이고 동사는 "granted"이며, 그 사이의 "which also gave ... partly own"은 쉼표로 시작된 비필수 관계절이다. 삽입절은 시작한 부호와 같은 부호로 닫아야 하므로 쉼표를 쓴 B가 정답이다. A는 세미콜론이 주어와 동사를 갈라놓아 앞부분이 독립절이 되지 못한다. C는 대시로 삽입절을 닫아 여는 쉼표와 짝이 맞지 않는다. D의 콜론도 주어와 동사 사이에 올 수 없고 앞부분이 완전한 절이 아니다.
g.explanation_en: Here the subject is "The cooperative's approach" and its verb is "granted." The clause "which also gave ... partly own" sits between them as a nonessential relative clause that opens with a comma. A nonessential clause has to close with the same mark it opened with, so B, which uses a comma, is correct. A puts a semicolon between the subject and the verb, and what comes before the semicolon isn't an independent clause. C closes the clause with a dash, which doesn't match the opening comma. D puts a colon between the subject and the verb, which isn't allowed, and what comes before the colon isn't a complete clause either.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.

c.seed: economics and business — Norwegian fisheries management and individual transferable quota system regulating North Sea stocks

g.passage: Before Norway introduced transferable quotas for its North Sea herring and cod fleets, vessels raced to land as much fish as possible before seasonal limits were reached, a pattern that rewarded speed over care. Under the newer system, each vessel owner holds a fixed share of the annual catch that can be bought or sold. Economists studying the reform note that this arrangement ______ the race itself: because a guaranteed share cannot be lost to faster rivals, owners now spread their fishing across the year and time landings to periods when market prices are highest.
g.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
options: intensified
documented
removed the incentive for
redirected the profits of
g.explanation: 지문은 보장된 할당 몫은 더 빠른 경쟁자에게 빼앗길 수 없으므로 선주들이 조업을 1년 내내 분산한다고 설명한다. 즉 이 제도는 조업 경쟁에 나설 이유 자체를 없앴으므로 C가 정답이다. A는 '경쟁이 심해졌다'는 뜻이라 조업 분산이라는 결과와 정반대이다. B는 기록했다는 뜻일 뿐, 제도가 행동을 바꾼 인과 관계를 담지 못한다. D는 수익과 시장 가격이 언급되어 그럴듯하지만, 지문의 요지는 경쟁의 수익이 다른 곳으로 옮겨 간 것이 아니라 경쟁 자체가 불필요해졌다는 점이다.
g.explanation_en: The passage says a guaranteed share can't be lost to faster rivals, so owners now spread their fishing across the year. That means the system took away any reason to race, so C is correct. A says the race got more intense, which is the opposite of what happens when owners spread out their fishing. B only means the system recorded the race, and it doesn't capture the cause-and-effect change the passage describes. D sounds plausible because the passage mentions prices and profit, but the point isn't that the race's profits moved somewhere else; it's that racing stopped being necessary at all.
g.design: To answer, students have to connect the quota mechanism (a share no rival can take) with the change in behavior (fishing spread across the year). D is tempting because the passage mentions market prices, and A is tempting for anyone who skims and only notices the word "race."

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.

c.seed: economics and business — Mauritian sugar plantation economy transition to tourism sector and labor market reallocation

g.passage: When Mauritius's sugar industry lost its preferential European prices in the mid-2000s, many economists predicted widespread unemployment among plantation workers. Instead, a study of the island's labor market found that the transition was ______: rather than being abruptly laid off, older cane cutters were offered voluntary retirement packages over several years, while younger workers were gradually retrained for jobs in the expanding hotel and tourism sector.
g.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
options: inevitable
profitable
controversial
staggered
g.explanation: 콜론 뒤 내용은 갑작스러운 해고 대신 수년에 걸친 자발적 은퇴와 점진적 재교육, 즉 단계적으로 나뉘어 진행된 전환을 설명하므로 D(staggered)가 정확하다. A는 산업 붕괴 맥락상 그럴듯하지만 지문은 전환의 불가피성이 아니라 진행 방식을 설명한다. B는 관광 부문 확장과 연결되어 보이나 수익성에 대한 근거는 없다. C는 경제학자들의 예측과 대비되어 보이지만 논쟁이 있었다는 정보는 제시되지 않는다.
g.explanation_en: The text after the colon describes a transition that was spread out over time: voluntary retirement offered over several years and workers retrained gradually instead of being laid off all at once. That makes D ("staggered") the precise choice. A may seem reasonable since the sugar industry lost its price support, but the text explains how the transition happened, not whether it could have been avoided. B links to the growing tourism sector, but nothing in the text talks about profits. C might seem to fit the economists' failed predictions, but the text never mentions any dispute over the transition.
g.design: 각 오답은 맥락의 일부 요소(산업 붕괴, 관광 확장, 예측과의 대비)에 기대도록 했다. 이 오답들을 배제하려면 콜론 뒤의 '수년에 걸쳐', '점진적으로'를 '전환 방식'과 연결해 읽어야 한다.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.

c.seed: economics and business — Turkish carpet weaving cottage industry and design copyright protection in handicraft markets

g.passage: In rural Anatolia, carpet weavers working from home have long passed motifs from one generation to the next, treating them as shared village heritage rather than private property. When export firms began registering some of these traditional patterns as their own designs, economist Elif Kaya argued that copyright law, built to reward individual creators, was poorly suited to such crafts. Because a motif may have been refined by hundreds of weavers over centuries, she noted, any attempt to ______ it to a single author is largely arbitrary.
g.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
options: attribute
restrict
reveal
adapt
g.design: 오답 B·C·D 모두 저작권·디자인 맥락과 부분적으로 연결되지만, 'to a single author'와 '수백 명이 다듬은 문양'이라는 두 정보를 연결해야 '저작자로 귀속시키다'만 남도록 설계했다.
g.explanation: 지문은 하나의 문양을 수백 명의 직조공이 수 세기에 걸쳐 다듬었기 때문에 이를 한 명의 저자에게 돌리려는 시도가 자의적이라고 말하므로, '~의 것으로 돌리다'라는 뜻의 A가 정답이다. B는 수출 기업의 등록이 문양 사용을 제한한다는 맥락과 맞아 보이지만, 'restrict it to a single author'는 누가 만들었는지가 아니라 누가 쓸 수 있는지에 관한 말이어서 '여러 창작자'라는 근거와 이어지지 않는다. C는 문양을 한 저자에게 '드러낸다'는 뜻이 되어 논리가 맞지 않는다. D는 공예 전통에서 문양을 변형한다는 말로 그럴듯하지만, 저작자를 정하는 일이 자의적이라는 논점과 관계가 없다.
g.explanation_en: The text says a motif was refined by hundreds of weavers over centuries, so trying to credit it to one author would be arbitrary. That makes A, "attribute," the right answer. B might seem to fit because registering a design does limit who can use it, but "restrict it to a single author" is about who may use the motif, not who made it, so it doesn't connect to the point about many creators. C would mean "revealing" the motif to an author, which doesn't make sense here. D fits the general idea of crafts changing designs, but it has nothing to do with the claim that naming a single author is arbitrary.

c.instruction:
- medium: 표준 SAT 중간 난이도. 두 단계 판단(규칙 적용 + 문맥 확인, 또는 두 정보의 연결)이 필요하다. 정답은 정독하면 명확하지만 훑어 읽으면 틀리게 설계한다. 오답 3개 중 최소 2개는 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 비교해야만 배제되고, 나머지 하나도 말이 되어야 한다.
